items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: That's Henry, isn't it? I'm not sure. I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: And the bass player is Henry.

And his brother, his other brother was playing. Oh, I thought I wondered which brother. He had another brother playing bass. That's Henry, isn't it? I'm not sure. I can't think of his name. Well, we have that anyway. Yeah.
